title: Call courage what happens after ego kneels
summary: Courage begins where ego kneels instead of swelling. When self-conceit forgets Naam, treat the pain as a warning.
takeaway: When self-conceit forgets Naam, treat the pain as a warning.
lifeApplication: Before calling yourself brave, lower the self-conceit that has made Naam feel optional.

source.shortMeaning: Courage begins where ego kneels instead of swelling.
source.lifeApplication: Before proving strength, choose the act that lowers ego instead.
